prompt: Why can the technician investigate later?
promptZh: 技術人員為什麼能事後調查？

options.text: Visitors keep a copy of the check-in list.
options.zh: 訪客保留了一份報到名單。
options.whyZh: 報到名單和顯示器暫時黑屏的原因無關。

options.text: Support staff can see the fault when they arrive.
options.zh: 支援人員到場時可以看到故障。
options.whyZh: 接待人員說支援人員尚未到場，畫面就已恢復。

options.text: The laptop saves an image of the blank screen.
options.zh: 筆記型電腦會存下黑屏畫面。
options.whyZh: 筆電只用於報到，沒有提到它會擷取主螢幕畫面。

options.text: The technician can match the time of the fault to the log.
options.zh: 技術人員能把故障時間和日誌紀錄比對。
options.whyZh: 發生時先記下時間。技術人員不用親眼看到黑屏，也能在畫面恢復後依時間比對控制器紀錄。

explanationZh: 發生時先記下時間。技術人員不用親眼看到黑屏，也能在畫面恢復後依時間比對控制器紀錄。
evidence: We’ll use that at the counter. The main display always comes back before support arrives. / Note the time if it goes blank again. I can match it to the controller log afterward.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: We’ll use that at the counter. The main display always comes back before support arrives.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Note the time if it goes blank again. I can match it to the controller log afterward.
